entities.name: Trine
entities.description: Serra Angel summoned by Xarl and bound as a fallen angel for 326 years; forgiven by Rahel and carried to Serra in death.

entities.name: Xarl Angel-Keeper
entities.description: Archmage who summoned Trine and bound her with a Horned Halo.

entities.name: Horned Halo
entities.description: Item placed on Trine's head that bound her to Xarl.

entities.name: Eskil
entities.description: Xarl's great-great-grandson, who summoned Rahel to fight Trine; blinded and bleached white, he ascended.

entities.name: Rahel
entities.description: Serran Angel summoned by Eskil to fight Trine; forgave Trine's crimes.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Realm freed in the north by Eskil.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Realm to which Trine was carried.

entities.name: Absolution of Trine
entities.description: Rahel's forgiveness of Trine for her crimes.

events.summary: Xarl places a Horned Halo on Trine's head, binding her and making her a fallen angel.
events.quote: Xarl placed a Horned Halo on Trine's head, binding her to him and making her a fallen angel

events.summary: Eskil summons the Serran Angel Rahel to fight Trine and free northern Corondor.
events.quote: Eskil , Xarl's great-great-grandson summoned the Serran Angel Rahel to fight Trine and free northern Corondor

events.summary: Rahel forgives Trine; in death Trine reverts to a Serra Angel and is carried off to Serra.
events.quote: Rahel forgave Trine for her crimes

relations.note: Enslaved to him by the Horned Halo.
